7116.title: Concurrent catalog bridge retirement
7116.rootCauseOneLine: Stale bridge retirement mistakes an unregistered same-launch sibling with a different skill catalog for an obsolete process.

prReviews.verdict: Static: addresses the verified discriminator error; branch not executed

7116.proposedFix: Compare bridge-launch identity separately from the skill-catalog process key before retiring an unregistered sibling.
7116.caveats: Runtime-level echo bridge reproduction only; no live Claude/Composer session. One or both starts may fail depending on scheduling. Open linked PR 7117 prevents a duplicate fix PR. Exact test and sanitized logs are inline; raw evidence remains local per reports repository policy.
